 CBSE Date Sheet 2027: Class 10th, 12th board exam timetable PDF soon, expected date here
 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to release the subject-wise timetable soon on its official website, cbse.gov.in. Students can check the complete details here to learn more.
 Curated By Akshita Jolly 
 Image: Canva 
 Nov 05, 2026
 Share
 The Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) is expected to publish the subject-wise timetable soon on its official website, cbse.gov.in. The timetable will have subject-wise exam dates, timings and other important instructions for students appearing in the upcoming board exams.  
 The date sheet can be released anytime soon. However, there is no official confirmation yet. The CBSE Class 10 and Class 12 board examinations for 2027 are expected to take place between February and March, based on previous years' trends. More than 45 lakh students are expected to appear for the exams. The papers are expected to be conducted in pen-and-paper mode, with each examination lasting two and a half hours, subject to the official instructions. 
 CBSE Date Sheet 2027: Important highlights 
 Students can check the important highlights here:  
 Board: Central Board of Secondary Education 
 Examination: Class 10 and Class 12 board exams 
 Academic session: 2026–27 
 Date sheet status: Awaited 
 Expected release: Soon; no official date confirmed 
 Expected exam period: February to April 2027 
 Official website: cbse.gov.in 
 What are the steps to download the CBSE Date Sheet 2027? 
 Here are the steps provided below to download the CBSE Date Sheet 2027 
 Visit the official website, cbse.gov.in. 
 Look for the CBSE Class 10 or Class 12 Date Sheet 2027 link. 
 Click on the relevant link to open the timetable PDF. 
 Check the subject-wise examination dates and timings. 
 Download the PDF and save it for future reference. 
 Keep visiting the official website for more such updates and notifications.
